adaptation.rule: Landscape screenshots default to 1440px PC layout width unless the user specifies another width.

strategy: Rendered a dedicated Nubo cloud storage dashboard page from page-local design-token and UI-DSL artifacts.
Ignored the gray presentation canvas and rounded showcase wrapper from the screenshot; the app shell itself is the rendered root.
Applied one shared app-shell background color across sidebar, topbar, main pane, and root to avoid a visible neutral-color seam.
Used normalized 1440px desktop proportions for sidebar, main pane, folder cards, storage overview, table rows, and controls.
Rendered folder summary cards with a flexing centered media region and a bottom-anchored text stack instead of a natural vertical stack.
Used local SVG/CSS approximations for the Nubo logo, folder illustrations, avatar, and file-type icons instead of external assets.

desktop.topbar: sticky top-0 z-40 full-bleed opaque header covering scroll-container top gutter

verification_observed: Source inspection confirmed desktop app shell classes: lg:flex, lg:h-screen, lg:overflow-hidden on the root.
Source inspection confirmed sidebar persistence with lg:sticky lg:top-0 lg:h-screen and internal overflow-y-auto.
Source inspection confirmed the main content pane owns desktop vertical scrolling with lg:h-screen lg:overflow-y-auto.
Source inspection confirmed the top header is sticky with top-0, a solid background, and full-bleed horizontal coverage.
The main content scroll container no longer puts top padding outside the sticky topbar; the visual top padding is inside the opaque sticky header.

shadow_mapping.policy: Treat elevation as high-risk; do not map low elevation mechanically.
removed_or_avoided: Presentation wrapper shadow excluded from app root
sticky_bleed_fix: Moved the main scroll container's top padding into the sticky topbar.
Made the sticky topbar full-bleed across the main pane with negative horizontal margin and matching inner padding.
Raised the sticky topbar z-index from z-20 to z-40 so scrolled dashboard content cannot show through the top gutter.
background_and_card_alignment_fix: Updated design tokens so app shell, sidebar, main stage, and topbar share #F4F6FA.
Updated UI DSL folder cards with content_distribution = media_fills_remaining_space, media_alignment = center, and bottom metadata stacks.
Updated Nubo folder cards to use a flex column with a centered flex-1 media region and mt-auto bottom text stack.

remaining.reason: Subtle edge contrast on miniature document glyphs.

commands.notes: Desktop shell and scoped scroll classes are present. No shadow-card or shadow-soft class is used by the Nubo page.

browser_checks.notes: DOM contained Nubo, Good morning, Bella!, Storage overview, Recent files, and job-contract-2026.pdf. Old FlowMail and All Integrations text was absent.
No console error logs were reported.
Document title resolved to Nubo Storage Dashboard after the page router title update.
Visible screenshot showed the Nubo sidebar, dashboard greeting, folder cards, storage overview, and recent files table without obvious overlap or clipping in the viewport.

After scrolling the main content area, the sticky topbar kept an opaque full-bleed background. Scrolled content no longer appeared through the topbar gutter; only Dashboard, notification, and avatar controls were visible in the topbar region.

browser_checks.tool: Browser plugin screenshot after background/card fix
browser_checks.notes: Narrow viewport screenshot showed the sidebar and main area using the same pale app-shell background. Folder cards used centered illustrations in the available media area with the label/count stack anchored to the lower card area.

limitations: An earlier Browser plugin CUA scroll action failed with no element at the requested point, and a locator keyboard scroll failed due to focus mismatch. A later coordinate-based CUA scroll succeeded and verified the sticky topbar bleed fix.
The later full viewport screenshot call timed out after a reload, but the earlier screenshot succeeded and later DOM/title/console checks passed.
